title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The Decision of the AI Office outlines the key policies and guidelines adopted by the office to govern the use and development of artificial intelligence. It emphasizes compliance, safety, and transparency while providing a framework for decision‑making and oversight.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: This document outlines the opening for new technology specialist positions focused on AI within the AI Office. It details the responsibilities, required skills, and application process for candidates seeking to contribute to the organization’s AI initiatives.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: This policy document announces a vacancy for the Lead Scientific Adviser role in the AI Office. It explains the duties of the position, the required qualifications, and how to apply.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: The policy explains what legal officers in an organization should do when managing AI projects, including reviewing contracts, overseeing data privacy, and ensuring compliance with regulations. It also sets out the standards for transparency, accountability, and risk assessment that legal staff must enforce to keep AI use legal and ethical.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: The policy announces a vacancy for AI Policy Officers, outlining the role’s responsibilities, required qualifications, and application procedures. Applicants are invited to apply, with emphasis on experience in AI ethics, policy, and governance.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The policy document explains the role of the Scientific Panel in reviewing the AI Act, detailing how the panel will evaluate the Act’s technical and scientific aspects. It emphasizes that the panel’s recommendations aim to ensure the legislation incorporates accurate scientific knowledge and best practices for regulating AI systems.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: This document proposes a request to standardize AI practices and guidelines. It outlines the need for consistent definitions, metrics, and regulatory frameworks to ensure AI systems operate safely and transparently.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: This notice announces a consultation on establishing a Community of Practice (CoP) for AI. It invites stakeholders to give feedback on the CoP’s goals, structure, and how it will guide responsible AI development and use.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: A call for expression of interest invites individuals or organizations to show interest in joining a Community of Practice focused on AI policy. The document outlines the purpose of the community, the benefits of participation, and the steps to apply or get involved.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: This document gives a visual overview of how a Community of Practice (CoP) iteratively drafts its policies. It explains the steps and feedback loops used to refine policy drafts within the CoP.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: The document is a graphic that outlines the sequence of steps taken to draft the AI policy for the Community of Practice. It shows key milestones and dates, helping stakeholders understand how the policy was developed over time.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: The “Code of Practice: 1st Draft” presents early guidelines for responsible AI design, use, and governance, focusing on transparency, fairness, and accountability. It serves as a foundation for further refining policies and ensuring AI systems adhere to ethical and regulatory standards.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This document presents the second draft of a Code of Practice for AI. It sets out guidelines and responsibilities to help developers and users create and use AI systems safely, ethically, and responsibly.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document presents a set of guidelines for responsible AI use, marking the third revision of the code of practice. It aims to give organizations clear standards and procedures to promote ethical, transparent, and accountable AI deployment.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: AI Pact Draft is a proposal for an international agreement that outlines shared principles and commitments for the safe, responsible, and inclusive use of artificial intelligence. It aims to establish collaborative standards, promote transparency, and address ethical, security, and societal impacts of AI technologies.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a set of agreements designed to guide the responsible development and use of artificial intelligence. It outlines principles, safety measures, and collaboration frameworks to ensure AI technologies are developed in ways that are ethical, transparent, and beneficial to society.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: The document outlines AI practices that are not allowed. It provides a set of rules to help organizations avoid using AI in ways that could harm individuals or society.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This policy outlines the criteria for determining what counts as an AI system, setting clear definitions, scope, and key characteristics. It provides guidance on how to classify and identify AI systems to ensure consistent risk assessment and regulatory compliance.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy outlines strategies to enhance communication efforts that support start‑ups and foster innovation within the AI sector. It aims to create a collaborative environment, share best practices, and provide resources to accelerate growth and technological advancements.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start‑Ups is a program that gives early‑stage companies access to powerful high‑performance computing resources, along with training and support. It aims to help these startups innovate and grow by connecting them with experts, funding, and industry partners.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This document presents a webinar slideshow that focuses on risk management in AI, outlining how to identify, assess, and mitigate potential risks. It offers practical strategies and best practices for organizations to protect themselves against AI‑related threats.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar discusses how to identify, assess, and mitigate risks in business and technology settings. It offers practical advice and real‑world examples to help viewers implement effective risk‑management strategies.
